title: Software Engineer - Healthcare AI
description: Position: Software Engineer - Healthcare AI Job Type: Full-Time Start Date: By agreement Location: Zürich - hybrid, with most working days in the office Language: English; German is a plus About the Role At Enzian Labs, we believe technology can make healthcare work better for everyone - from patients and clinicians to the people operating complex healthcare systems. We build software and AI solutions that turn fragmented information and difficult workflows into useful, reliable products. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to improve and extend our existing healthcare products. Your initial work will focus on data pipelines, and integrations, including workflows that turn healthcare documents into usable data. As our products evolve, you will contribute to new projects, including web or mobile applications. You will develop AI-enabled workflows that transform complex healthcare data into dependable, usable systems. You will work closely with our technical lead and product stakeholders, owning substantial parts of implementation from initial design through production deployment. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an experienced engineer who enjoys data-intensive systems, pragmatic architecture, and solving meaningful problems in healthcare, while embracing the entrepreneurial spirit of a growing start-up. What you’ll do Build Full-Stack applications to enable operation workflows for clinician and healthcare staff. Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that support healthcare workflows. Develop and improve pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and export structured and unstructured data. Integrate AI capabilities where they help solve a product problem, with appropriate evaluation, validation, and failure handling. Work with product stakeholders to clarify requirements, make practical trade-offs, and deliver features that address user needs. Build with care for sensitive healthcare data, including privacy, access control, and auditability. What you’ll bring At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, with examples of features or systems you’ve owned through production. Practical experience with backend services, APIs, and relational databases, including work that involved processing or validating data. Sound engineering judgment around testing, maintainability, security, and diagnosing production issues. Comfort working through ambiguous requirements and learning new tools or parts of the stack as projects evolve. Experience that would be helpful Building or operating software on GCP or another major cloud platform. Working in Healthcare or another environment that handles sensitive data. Experienced with EU MDR or similar medical certifications. Building user-facing features for web or mobile applications. German is a plus for our client interactions. Engagement Details This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, with most working days spent together in the office. You will join a small team where engineers remain close to product decisions and the real-world impact of their work. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team or act as the technical lead. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
